Mission Brief

What we actually do

The Cosmos Agency is a full-service Passes management agency. Our fifteen-person crew handles your chatting, your growth strategy, your marketing, and the day-to-day relationships that pay your bills — morning, afternoon, evening, and graveyard.

You focus on content. We focus on turning it into revenue, and on proving it with numbers you can check yourself. That's the whole pitch: we are the best in the business at making our creators money, and the three case studies below are how we back that up.
